title: Game Artist / Game Visual Designer - Mobile Games
description:
Job Title: Game Artist / Game Visual Designer - Mobile Games Experience: 1-4 Years Employment Type: Full-Time We are looking for a creative Game Artist / Game Visual Designer to create engaging visual experiences for mobile games. The role will primarily focus on character design, animation, VFX, 2D/3D game assets, and visual elements that make games polished and engaging. Key Responsibilities: Create and animate 2D/3D game characters, objects, and visual assets Design game animations, VFX, effects, transitions, and interactions Create game UI elements such as buttons, icons, pop-ups, rewards, HUD elements, and menus Develop visual styles and assets for casual, hyper-casual, and hybrid-casual games Create character animations and skeletal animations using Spine 2D Create or modify 3D assets and visuals where required Work closely with Game Designers and Unity Developers to implement assets in the game Optimize visual assets and animations for mobile performance Must Have: Strong experience in 2D game art and visual design Good understanding of game animation and VFX Experience designing characters, game objects, icons, and other game assets Strong understanding of color, composition, lighting, and visual hierarchy Experience with Figma Experience with Adobe Photoshop Experience with Adobe Illustrator Understanding of mobile game design and visual trends Good to Have: Spine 2D - character/skeletal animation Blender - 3D modeling and assets Unity - understanding of game implementation After Effects - motion graphics/VFX Maya / Cinema 4D Procreate Portfolio: Portfolio is mandatory. Candidates should provide examples of: Game characters Character animations 2D/3D game assets VFX/effects Game UI Game animations Spine 2D work, if available Published/shipped games, if applicable Ideal Candidate: Someone who is strong in game visuals and animation, not just static UI design, and can contribute to the complete visual development process, including: CharacteD/3D Assets Animation VFX UI Visuals Overall Game Look Feel 

Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
